payload.reason: The evidence indicates that there is a difference in completion rates between those who received personalised and non-personalised texts, with non-personalised texts leading to higher completion rates.

claims.text: Those who received non-personalised text messages were more likely to complete the questionnaire than those who received personalised text messages, with an adjusted odds ratio of 0.44 (95% CI 0.22-0.87, p=0.02).
There was no evidence of a difference in the number of attempts to contact required between those who received personalised and non-personalised text messages (p=0.23).
The average time to completion of the questionnaire was similar for both groups, but there was a slight difference in time to completion between personalised and non-personalised texts.
